name: ipapi.is
summary: IP address intelligence: geolocation, ASN, owning company and abuse contact, and VPN, proxy, Tor, datacenter and crawler detection.

api_key.description: an ipapi.is API key (free account: 1,000 requests a day). Optional for single IP lookups, required for ASN lookups and the account endpoint

notes: Without a key: 30 lookups per IP per UTC day, with a minimal response and no detection flags; the next requests get 429 ERR_FREE_TIER_EXHAUSTED, and persisting can get the IP firewalled for 24 hours.
A free account key allows 1,000 requests a day; errors are not counted. 429 ERR_QUOTA_EXCEEDED means the daily quota is spent.
Switch parameters (pretty, geoloc_meta, all_companies) take effect only with the exact value 1.
Errors are JSON with error and error_code (e.g. 400 ERR_INVALID_IP_OR_ASN, 403 ERR_FORBIDDEN_API_KEY_REQUIRED).

endpoints.name: Look up an IP address
endpoints.summary: Location, ASN, company, abuse contact and is_vpn/is_proxy/is_tor/is_datacenter/is_abuser/is_mobile/is_crawler flags for an IPv4 or IPv6 address.

q.description: The IP address; omit for the caller's own IP.

all_companies.description: 1 returns every matching WHOIS record as an array in company.

endpoints.name: Look up an autonomous system
endpoints.summary: Details of an autonomous system number.

q.description: The ASN with the AS prefix.

endpoints.name: Get plan and usage
endpoints.summary: The key's plan, daily limit and requests used.
